note: Exclusion of undesirable persons order printed continuously from leaf 221 (printed p. 220) to this leaf (printed p. 222), which carries Secs. 11-15, signature, dateline and No. 2527.
April 15, 1913 appears only as a citation to the quarantine order No. 1761; nothing about North Dakota land districts is on the page.
April 15, 1913 appears only as a citation to the quarantine order No. 1761; nothing about the Fargo or Bismarck land districts is on the page.
Sec. 13 of the Feb. 6, 1917 order re-enacts the quarantine rules of the order dated April 15, 1913 (No. 1761), cited only, not printed (footnote points to p. 143).
Sec. 13 of the Feb. 6, 1917 order cites the January 11, 1915 quarantine amendment (No. 2118) only; its text is printed elsewhere (p. 206).

The printed [No. 1371.] closes the May 23, 1917 Panama Canal neutrality proclamation (a proclamation number), not the 1911 Civil Service Schedule A order.
